title: QUBE Discovery Lab
text: The QUBE Discovery Lab prepares young people to apply mathematical, computational, and statistical reasoning to real-world biological and health problems.

title: QUBE Discovery Lab
text:
What Participants Do

Data-Driven Inquiry: Explore datasets from life sciences, clinical medicine, environmental health, and public health.
Computational & Statistical Skills: Build practical experience in data visualization, statistical modeling, and scientific reasoning.
Mentored Research Projects: Collaborate in teams with guidance from QUBE’s Graduate Student Advisors and Expert Advisors to prepare projects for the QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium.

title: QUBE Youth Scholars Network
text:
Open to All: QUBE programs are open to all middle and high school students who are curious about applying math, data, and science to real-world challenges in biology, medicine, and public health. The program is free!
All Levels Welcome: All levels of learners are welcome—whether you are taking your first steps in data analysis or already working on quantitative research.
Growth Path: Through structured training, mentorship, and project-based learning, participants progress from foundational to advanced analytical skills, gaining both technical expertise and the confidence to contribute meaningfully as emerging data scientists, health researchers, and changemakers.

title: QUBE Youth Scholars Network
text:
How to Get Involved

Connect with a local chapter via our Branch Leadership network across the United States, Canada, and China.
Participate in workshops, peer learning cohorts, and mentorship from our Graduate Student and Expert Advisors.
Reach out directly at qubeinitiative1@gmail.com to join the QUBE Youth Scholars Network.

title: QUBE Programs
text:
QUBE programs are free and open to all middle and high school students who are curious about applying math, data, and science to real-world challenges in biology, medicine, and public health. All levels of learners are welcome!
Through structured training, mentorship, and project-based learning, participants progress from foundational to advanced analytical skills, gaining both technical expertise and the confidence to contribute meaningfully as emerging data scientists, health researchers, and changemakers.

title: QUBE Programs
text:
Our Four Core Programs

1. QUBE Youth Scholars Network
Our core membership and mentorship network where middle and high school students build foundational-to-advanced analytical skills through structured training and collaborative learning.


2. QUBE Discovery Lab
Hands-on, project-based quantitative research where students apply mathematical, computational, and statistical reasoning to real-world biological and health problems.


3. QUBE Science and Leadership Forum
Monthly live Zoom seminars featuring leading researchers, clinicians, and industry biostatisticians/data scientists sharing how math, statistics, and data science drive discoveries in medicine and public health.


4. QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium
An annual showcase where QUBE student scholars present their interdisciplinary data science and health research projects to peers, mentors, and expert advisors.

title: QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium
text: The QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium brings together students from the QUBE Youth Scholars Network and QUBE Discovery Lab to present their analytical projects and scientific findings.

title: QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium
text:
Symposium Highlights

Student Research Presentations: Middle and high school scholars present data-driven research addressing challenges in biology, medicine, environmental health, and public health.
Expert Feedback: Receive constructive feedback and mentorship from QUBE’s Board Directors, Expert Advisors, and Graduate Student Advisors.
Global Community Exchange: Connect with youth researchers across QUBE’s U.S. and international branches.


Interested in presenting or attending? Contact us at qubeinitiative1@gmail.com.

title: QUBE INITIATIVE
text:
Mission & Vision

Mission Statement
QUBE is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering youth to explore the intersection of data, life sciences, medicine, and public health. We believe that understanding data-driven decision-making is essential for addressing today’s challenges in health and society.
Through mentorship, hands-on learning, and interdisciplinary collaboration, QUBE prepares young people to apply mathematical, computational, and statistical reasoning to real-world biological and health problems, nurturing informed, innovative, and compassionate leaders of tomorrow.


Vision Statement
To inspire and equip the next generation of problem-solvers with the analytical, scientific, and ethical tools to improve health and well-being, from biological systems to community outcomes, around the world.

text:

Executive Committee
Meet our Founder & President and Directors leading QUBE’s global strategy, communications, and educational programs.


Branch Leadership
Discover our student-led regional branches spanning 8 U.S. states, Canada, and China.


Advisors
Learn about our Board Directors, Expert Advisors, and Graduate Student Advisors from Harvard, University of Michigan, MD Anderson, and Guangzhou University.



Our Four Free Programs
QUBE programs are free and open to all middle and high school students of all learning levels:



1. QUBE Youth Scholars Network
Structured training, mentorship, and project-based learning for emerging data scientists and health researchers.


2. QUBE Discovery Lab
Hands-on exploration and collaborative quantitative research in biology, medicine, and public health.


3. QUBE Science and Leadership Forum
Monthly 2026 live seminars featuring distinguished faculty, clinicians, and industry data scientists.


4. QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium
A platform for youth scholars to present their research findings and quantitative health projects.
